title: Ledger Entry Types
key_points: The XRPL Ledger has several types of entries, including Accounts, Transactions, and Snapshots.
Each entry type serves a specific purpose in maintaining the integrity of the ledger.
This reference guide provides details on how to identify and interpret these different entry types.
limitations: The source is focused solely on explaining XRPL-specific concepts without broader context.
asserts: The XRPL Ledger utilizes various entry types, including Accounts, Transactions, and Snapshots, each serving distinct purposes in maintaining the ledger's integrity.
